reproduction.launch: python3 scripts/bench.py launch --benchmark aibench-coding --profile smoke --method goal-plus-codex --model bench-openai/gpt-5.6-sol --reasoning-effort medium --wall-time-seconds 1800 --live-search-concurrency 1 --cell-concurrency 1 --seed 1 --campaign-id <new-campaign-id>

limitations: This smoke proves one valid _clean2026 task on Linux with Goal Plus + Codex at K=1, C=1, and R=1; it does not prove the full case set.
Plain Codex, Plain Pi, Goal Plus + Pi, native baseline, K>1, and matched cross-method campaigns remain separately unproven.
The development run preceded implementation commit 0c4fef8; the dirty-at-prepare provenance is retained rather than rewritten.
